More chromas can be specified with both the @numchroma attribute and by providing the maximum number of chromas as the first argument. You can allocate a higher maximum chroma than numchromas. However, this will result in empty channels that you will need to account for.

The chroma values are also scaled with @normalize 1, meaning each collection of chromas will sum to a value of 1.
